name: Northeast Family Foot Care
address: 9892 Bustleton Avenue, First Floor, Philadelphia, PA 19115
description: Podiatry office in Northeast Philadelphia for adults and children, led by Amy B. Lustig, DPM since 2001.

hero.headline: Northeast Family Foot Care
hero.sub: Amy B. Lustig, DPM opened this office in 2001 so kids through seniors in Northeast Philadelphia could get foot and ankle care in one place.

items: Comprehensive foot and ankle care for adults and children
First-visit intake with insurance cards and current medications
Reminder calls the business day before a scheduled appointment
Office opened in 2001 by Amy B. Lustig, DPM
Published phone 215-673-3200 on the official homepage
Address listed as 9892 Bustleton Avenue, First Floor, Philadelphia, PA 19115
Hours published as Mon-Tue 9:00am-5:30pm and Wed-Thu 9:00am-5:00pm

story.heading: About
paragraphs: The official homepage says Amy Lustig, DPM saw a need in Northeast Philadelphia for a welcoming foot care center in 2001.
The practice states it treats patients like family and wants everyone from kids to seniors to feel comfortable.

items: New patients are asked to arrive 15 minutes early so intake can be collected.
Bring insurance cards, primary-doctor name, allergies, and current medications.
The office asks for notice if you cannot keep an appointment after a reminder call.

feature.heading: Your feet do not have to hurt
feature.text: The official homepage says most foot pain can be relieved and lists patient satisfaction, compassion, and office cleanliness as top priorities.

spotlight.heading: Keep the visit on time
spotlight.text: The practice says it strives to keep appointment times on schedule. Confirm hours and availability on the official site before you travel.
